turns.replyText:
What's your return and refund policy?
Our return and refund policy is designed to ensure a smooth process for you. Here are the key details:
Returns:
You have 21 days from the date of delivery to return your items.
Items must be in their original condition – unworn, unwashed, and with tags still attached. Footwear should not have been worn outdoors.
If your purchase was made in one of our physical stores, returns must be completed in-store within the same 21-day window.
For hygiene reasons, boxers can only be returned if they are unworn, unwashed, and in their original packaging with seals intact.
Refunds:
Once your return arrives at our warehouse, we aim to process it within 10 days.
After approval, your refund will be issued to your original payment method within 3-5 business days. You’ll receive an email confirmation once the refund is processed.
If you paid using a gift card, the refund will be issued back to the same gift card. For split payments, refunds will first be applied to the gift card portion.
Additional Notes:
Items remain your responsibility until they reach our warehouse. Please ensure your parcel is securely packaged and retain proof of postage.
If you’ve requested an exchange but the item is no longer available, a refund will be issued instead.
For full details, you can view our returns policy here. If you have any further questions, feel free to ask!
